title: Alastor So It's A Deal
blurb: Deals are Alastor's entire currency. Hazbin Hotel runs on infernal contracts: souls traded, favours owed, terms carefully left unexplained. This is the moment one of them closes, delivered with the delighted formality of a man who has just won something the other party has not yet noticed losing. Nearly five seconds, so you get the full flourish rather than a fragment of it. The clip has become the fandom's standard stamp for agreeing to anything faintly ill-advised, from group project splits to bets nobody should have taken.
origin: Alastor sealing a deal in Hazbin Hotel.
